proposed_claim: At the legal boundary, tree-cover-loss first-crossing odds were lower on the park side across all three territorial-control profiles.
primary_support: all three estimates negative; all three conditional intervals exclude zero
lag_support: negative at lags 1 and 2 for all profiles
threshold_support: negative at 10%; 50% estimates are weak and intervals include zero
spatial_domain_support: negative direction across 5, 10, 20 km and full domain; 5 km support is weaker
chronology_support: negative under lags and transition-year alternatives overall
episode_support: negative direction in all leave-one-episode-out fits
pseudoboundary_support: legal estimates are below all offsets in every audited design
caveat: Conditional spatial association; 50% measurement sensitivity is imprecise and the products are first-crossing measures.

proposed_claim: Fire boundary contrasts were positive for fragmented and park-centred profile years at lag 0, while the militia-centred interval included zero.
primary_support: fragmented and park-centred intervals exclude zero; militia-centred includes zero
lag_support: positive point estimates at lags 1 and 2, but some intervals include zero
threshold_support: fragmented positive; militia-centred and park-centred vary in interval exclusion
spatial_domain_support: positive point estimates across domains; some fits/intervals are non-strict
chronology_support: chronology changes magnitude and interval exclusion
episode_support: fragmented remains positive; militia- and park-centred signs can change
pseudoboundary_support: legal estimates lie within the offset range in every audited design
caveat: The quantity is burned cell-years rather than discrete fire-event counts; offset results do not show a unique legal-boundary pattern.

proposed_claim: The negative park-centred agricultural first-crossing contrast is support- and specification-sensitive.
primary_support: park-centred negative interval excludes zero; other profiles include zero
lag_support: park-centred is negative; lag-1 interval includes zero and lag-2 excludes zero
chronology_support: chronology sensitivity does not resolve sparse support
episode_support: park-centred remains negative; other profiles change sign
pseudoboundary_support: inconclusive; design-dependent ranges and sparse support
caveat: Only 518 primary-corridor events; annual cropland fractions are unavailable for persistence checks.

proposed_claim: The territorial-control categories identify actor-specific causal effects.
primary_support: none; design is observational and conditional
caveat: No causal identification of legal designation or individual actors.

proposed_claim: Post-loss forest recovery can be quantified from the retained Hansen products.
caveat: Cumulative Hansen loss cannot measure regrowth; annual validated canopy data are absent.

proposed_claim: Agricultural persistence or reversal can be quantified from the retained event-year product.
caveat: Annual AFCD fractions are absent; the event-year raster cannot reconstruct post-event states.
